title: Serialize checkpoint writers with an inter-process lock and remove session temps left by killed writers (issues 62 and 64)
description: Serialize checkpoint writers with an inter-process lock and remove session temps left by killed writers (issues 62 and 64)
no_spec_change_rationale: Checkpoint integrity within REQ-cli canonical checkpoint as written: one canonical checkpoint that writers replace atomically; serializing writers and removing temps left by dead writers restores that guarantee across processes without changing requirement or criterion text; docs/cli.md describes the lock and cleanup
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent chough checkpoint writers in one clone keep every update: in 8 rounds of three parallel writers every process succeeds and every decision observation and bug link is in the final checkpoint; a writer that cannot take the checkpoint lock within 30 seconds refuses with refused:checkpoint-busy and saves nothing; a session temp left by a writer killed before its rename is removed by the next checkpoint writer with a stderr notice naming it and the session keeps only saved updates while a writer killed after its rename keeps its update and nothing is removed; only regular files named .session.json.<digits>.tmp directly in .chough are removed and read-only commands remove nothing; init still leaves only .chough/session.json and refused writers still change nothing under .chough; the new tests fail with src at main 4daf861 and docs/cli.md describes the lock and cleanup and fledge lanes run verify passes; the test suite leaves no chough-checkpoint lock files in the system temporary directory

answers.constraints: Bounded bug fix for issues 62 and 64 only: one new runtime dependency fs4 1.1.0 for a cross-platform file lock that keeps MSRV 1.88 and the lock file lives in the system temp directory (both decided by Leif's CoS at 12:15 PM MT on 2026-11-03) so no new file appears in .chough or the project; tests remove the lock files they create; no CLI argument or JSON output change and no schema change; no PR until a corvid-agent PR slot is free
